# Customization

Read [coding instructions](../copilot-instructions.md) and the [content workflow](../../docs/CONTENT_WORKFLOW.md).

- Edit content in its documented data source, not generated `_site` files.
- Keep selected projects synchronized through the shared include.
- Use existing company assets and accessible icon labels.
- Keep the homepage concise. Longer personal context belongs in More About Me.
- Keep LLM systems, GPU computing and performance engineering as the site's focus. Describe earlier projects honestly.
- Use Geist Mono and the existing accent tokens. Preserve mobile layout, theme contrast and reduced-motion behavior.
- Validate with the production Jekyll build and browser checks in [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md).
- Do not commit, push or change cloud settings without user authorization.
